desc: Derive the exact minimum-move greedy simulation for checking whether a target minimum score x is achievable.
Validate the checker on the provided examples and construct edge cases such as n=2, very small m, and one extremely small points[i].
Prove the feasibility predicate is monotonic, enabling binary search over the answer.
Confirm the binary-search bounds based on m, points, and the requirement to visit every index.
Finalize the Python Solution.maxScore implementation after validation.
